'''Amber''' is a playable {{Pyro}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

As the only remaining Outrider of the [[Knights of Favonius]], she is always ready to help the citizens of [[Mondstadt]] — whether it be something simple or perhaps a more challenging task.

She can be obtained for free in the {{Quest|Wind-Riding Knight}}.

Lumine: {{w|ko:이새아|Lee Sae-ah ({{ko|이새아}})}} }} The '''Traveler''' is the playable protagonist of ''[[Genshin Impact]]''. In the opening cutscene, twin siblings from another world travel through the universe, until [[Asmoday]] blocked their path. The player gets to choose either '''Aether''' (male) or '''Lumine''' (female) as the Traveler and the [[Traveler's Sibling]] becomes captured. Their power to travel is sealed, leaving them stranded on [[Teyvat]]. They save [[Paimon]] by fishing her out of the water and she accompanies them as their new travel companion. Together they set out on a journey to find [[The Seven]] and reunite with the Traveler's lost sibling. Although players can choose the name they want to be referred by, the [[Traveler's Sibling]] refers to the Traveler by their real name, regardless of their custom name. In [[Natlan]], the Traveler also gains the [[Ancient Name]] {{Ancient Name|TMN|'''Tumaini'''|bearer=1}}. ==Gameplay Info== ===Ascensions and Stats=== {{Character Ascensions and Stats}} ===Elemental Alignment=== At the beginning of the game and in {{Quest|The Crux Clash (Quest)|showType=0}}, the Traveler is "unaligned," a special elemental state exclusive to them. When unaligned, the color of the Traveler's "vision" and background when they are selected in the [[Character Menu]] is gray. Although the Traveler's Profile lists their [[Constellation]] properly as Viator/Viatrix, attempting to open the Constellation tab will show a blank screen with "Constellation Unavailable" in the bottom-right corner. When unaligned, the Traveler has only one talent, Normal Attack: [[Past Memories]]. When unaligned, screens that show character cards with their elements show a gray "no" symbol (🚫︎) in the place of the element symbol. Shortly after the beginning of the game, the Traveler will unlock their {{Anemo}} Talents and Constellation by resonating with the first [[Statue of The Seven]] in [[Mondstadt]]. They can resonate with any other Statue of The Seven they find and change their element to match the statue's element. ''See [[Teyvat]] for each region's element.'' However, the Traveler does not immediately gain the {{Pyro}} element upon resonating with a Statue of The Seven in [[Natlan]], due to corrupted [[Ley Line]]s in the region. They instead unlock their abilities during {{Quest|Where All Hopes Lie|showType=0}}, and are able to properly resonate with Natlan's Statues of the Seven following this quest. The Traveler is able to gain additional talents for each element due to [[Columbina]] removing the restrictions placed upon them by the world. They unlock these effects after completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming|showType=0}}. Additionally, their stats are increased for each element whose Statues of the Seven the Traveler has resonated with. {{Traveler Talents and Constellations}} ===Gameplay Notes=== * After using {{LL|Activated・Canned Knowledge|}} during step 5 of {{Quest|Ever So Close}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 3. * After completing steps 2, 6, and 9 of {{Quest|Special Training (Story Quest)}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 7, Elemental Mastery by 15, and Base HP by 50 respectively. * After completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming}}, the following stats will increase for the Traveler upon resonating with an element from a Statue of The Seven at least once: ** {{Color|Anemo}}: CRIT Rate is increased by 10% ** {{Color|Geo}}: DEF is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Electro}}: Energy Recharge is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Dendro}}: Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 ** {{Color|Hydro}}: HP is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Pyro}}: ATK is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Cryo}}: CRIT DMG is increased by 20% ** Additionaly, because Anemo and Pyro are already acquired prior to completing the quest, those stat increases will automatically be active upon completing the quest. ==Availability== The '''Traveler''' is obtained at the start of the game and is not featured in any [[Wishes]]. ==Notes== {{Reflist|note=1}} ==Other Languages== '''Diluc Ragnvindr''' is a playable {{Pyro}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

Born into the affluent [[Ragnvindr Clan]], Diluc is the current owner of the [[Dawn Winery]] and a nobleman of high esteem in [[Mondstadt]]. While a past incident caused him to split ways with the [[Knights of Favonius]], he continues to protect Mondstadt in his own way.

She is the deaconess of the [[Church of Favonius]] and a prominent "idol" after learning about them from the intrepid adventurer [[Alice]]. She is also the younger sister of the Acting Grand Master [[Jean]].

Lumine: {{w|ko:이새아|Lee Sae-ah ({{ko|이새아}})}} }} The '''Traveler''' is the playable protagonist of ''[[Genshin Impact]]''. In the opening cutscene, twin siblings from another world travel through the universe, until [[Asmoday]] blocked their path. The player gets to choose either '''Aether''' (male) or '''Lumine''' (female) as the Traveler and the [[Traveler's Sibling]] becomes captured. Their power to travel is sealed, leaving them stranded on [[Teyvat]]. They save [[Paimon]] by fishing her out of the water and she accompanies them as their new travel companion. Together they set out on a journey to find [[The Seven]] and reunite with the Traveler's lost sibling. Although players can choose the name they want to be referred by, the [[Traveler's Sibling]] refers to the Traveler by their real name, regardless of their custom name. In [[Natlan]], the Traveler also gains the [[Ancient Name]] {{Ancient Name|TMN|'''Tumaini'''|bearer=1}}. ==Gameplay Info== ===Ascensions and Stats=== {{Character Ascensions and Stats}} ===Elemental Alignment=== At the beginning of the game and in {{Quest|The Crux Clash (Quest)|showType=0}}, the Traveler is "unaligned," a special elemental state exclusive to them. When unaligned, the color of the Traveler's "vision" and background when they are selected in the [[Character Menu]] is gray. Although the Traveler's Profile lists their [[Constellation]] properly as Viator/Viatrix, attempting to open the Constellation tab will show a blank screen with "Constellation Unavailable" in the bottom-right corner. When unaligned, the Traveler has only one talent, Normal Attack: [[Past Memories]]. When unaligned, screens that show character cards with their elements show a gray "no" symbol (🚫︎) in the place of the element symbol. Shortly after the beginning of the game, the Traveler will unlock their {{Anemo}} Talents and Constellation by resonating with the first [[Statue of The Seven]] in [[Mondstadt]]. They can resonate with any other Statue of The Seven they find and change their element to match the statue's element. ''See [[Teyvat]] for each region's element.'' However, the Traveler does not immediately gain the {{Pyro}} element upon resonating with a Statue of The Seven in [[Natlan]], due to corrupted [[Ley Line]]s in the region. They instead unlock their abilities during {{Quest|Where All Hopes Lie|showType=0}}, and are able to properly resonate with Natlan's Statues of the Seven following this quest. The Traveler is able to gain additional talents for each element due to [[Columbina]] removing the restrictions placed upon them by the world. They unlock these effects after completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming|showType=0}}. Additionally, their stats are increased for each element whose Statues of the Seven the Traveler has resonated with. {{Traveler Talents and Constellations}} ===Gameplay Notes=== * After using {{LL|Activated・Canned Knowledge|}} during step 5 of {{Quest|Ever So Close}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 3. * After completing steps 2, 6, and 9 of {{Quest|Special Training (Story Quest)}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 7, Elemental Mastery by 15, and Base HP by 50 respectively. * After completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming}}, the following stats will increase for the Traveler upon resonating with an element from a Statue of The Seven at least once: ** {{Color|Anemo}}: CRIT Rate is increased by 10% ** {{Color|Geo}}: DEF is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Electro}}: Energy Recharge is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Dendro}}: Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 ** {{Color|Hydro}}: HP is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Pyro}}: ATK is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Cryo}}: CRIT DMG is increased by 20% ** Additionaly, because Anemo and Pyro are already acquired prior to completing the quest, those stat increases will automatically be active upon completing the quest. ==Availability== The '''Traveler''' is obtained at the start of the game and is not featured in any [[Wishes]]. ==Notes== {{Reflist|note=1}} ==Other Languages== '''Ineffa''' is a playable {{Electro}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

She is a creation of [[Aino]], serving as an all-utility maid and battle automaton created from various scraps from across the nations. Her core originated from [[Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk]], the Eleventh of the [[Thirteen Sovereign Lords]], as the part of her who wanted to abandon her vendetta against humanity and find a new place to belong.

After reaching [[Friendship Level]] 6 with Ineffa, a {{Item|Krumkake Bolt}} may be obtained through the character menu.

'''Jahoda''' is a playable {{Anemo}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''. 

An employee of the [[Curatorium of Secrets]], a self-proclaimed legendary bounty hunter. A former member of the [[Seahook Gang]], she was taken in by [[Nefer]] to be the only front member, to cover up Nefer's informants and activities under the [[Northern Intelligence Network]].

They are gifted at exploring the mysteries sealed within the Miliastra Wonderland.}} The '''Wonderland Manekin''' is a playable [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]'', serving as the primary playable character of the [[Miliastra Wonderland]] gameplay mode. After unlocking Miliastra Wonderland, players will gain access to two versions of the Manekin: '''Manekin''' (male) and '''Manekina''' (female). The Manekins can be named, customized with [[Cosmetic Plan]]s, and used in Miliastra Wonderland and [[Teyvat]]. In Miliastra Wonderland, players can freely swap between the Manekin and the Manekina at any time. In Teyvat, players have both Manekins simultaneously as separate characters but they cannot both be used in the same team. The Manekin can be used in the open world and most domains, but not in gameplay modes such as the [[Spiral Abyss]], [[Imaginarium Theater]], and [[Stygian Onslaught]]. Lumine: {{w|ko:이새아|Lee Sae-ah ({{ko|이새아}})}} }} The '''Traveler''' is the playable protagonist of ''[[Genshin Impact]]''. In the opening cutscene, twin siblings from another world travel through the universe, until [[Asmoday]] blocked their path. The player gets to choose either '''Aether''' (male) or '''Lumine''' (female) as the Traveler and the [[Traveler's Sibling]] becomes captured. Their power to travel is sealed, leaving them stranded on [[Teyvat]]. They save [[Paimon]] by fishing her out of the water and she accompanies them as their new travel companion. Together they set out on a journey to find [[The Seven]] and reunite with the Traveler's lost sibling. Although players can choose the name they want to be referred by, the [[Traveler's Sibling]] refers to the Traveler by their real name, regardless of their custom name. In [[Natlan]], the Traveler also gains the [[Ancient Name]] {{Ancient Name|TMN|'''Tumaini'''|bearer=1}}. ==Gameplay Info== ===Ascensions and Stats=== {{Character Ascensions and Stats}} ===Elemental Alignment=== At the beginning of the game and in {{Quest|The Crux Clash (Quest)|showType=0}}, the Traveler is "unaligned," a special elemental state exclusive to them. When unaligned, the color of the Traveler's "vision" and background when they are selected in the [[Character Menu]] is gray. Although the Traveler's Profile lists their [[Constellation]] properly as Viator/Viatrix, attempting to open the Constellation tab will show a blank screen with "Constellation Unavailable" in the bottom-right corner. When unaligned, the Traveler has only one talent, Normal Attack: [[Past Memories]]. When unaligned, screens that show character cards with their elements show a gray "no" symbol (🚫︎) in the place of the element symbol. Shortly after the beginning of the game, the Traveler will unlock their {{Anemo}} Talents and Constellation by resonating with the first [[Statue of The Seven]] in [[Mondstadt]]. They can resonate with any other Statue of The Seven they find and change their element to match the statue's element. ''See [[Teyvat]] for each region's element.'' However, the Traveler does not immediately gain the {{Pyro}} element upon resonating with a Statue of The Seven in [[Natlan]], due to corrupted [[Ley Line]]s in the region. They instead unlock their abilities during {{Quest|Where All Hopes Lie|showType=0}}, and are able to properly resonate with Natlan's Statues of the Seven following this quest. The Traveler is able to gain additional talents for each element due to [[Columbina]] removing the restrictions placed upon them by the world. They unlock these effects after completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming|showType=0}}. Additionally, their stats are increased for each element whose Statues of the Seven the Traveler has resonated with. {{Traveler Talents and Constellations}} ===Gameplay Notes=== * After using {{LL|Activated・Canned Knowledge|}} during step 5 of {{Quest|Ever So Close}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 3. * After completing steps 2, 6, and 9 of {{Quest|Special Training (Story Quest)}}, the Traveler's Base ATK is permanently increased by 7, Elemental Mastery by 15, and Base HP by 50 respectively. * After completing step 7 of {{Quest|Welkin Moon's Homecoming}}, the following stats will increase for the Traveler upon resonating with an element from a Statue of The Seven at least once: ** {{Color|Anemo}}: CRIT Rate is increased by 10% ** {{Color|Geo}}: DEF is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Electro}}: Energy Recharge is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Dendro}}: Elemental Mastery is increased by 60 ** {{Color|Hydro}}: HP is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Pyro}}: ATK is increased by 20% ** {{Color|Cryo}}: CRIT DMG is increased by 20% ** Additionaly, because Anemo and Pyro are already acquired prior to completing the quest, those stat increases will automatically be active upon completing the quest. ==Availability== The '''Traveler''' is obtained at the start of the game and is not featured in any [[Wishes]]. ==Notes== {{Reflist|note=1}} ==Other Languages== '''Noelle''' is a playable {{Geo}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

Extremely strong and reliable, Noelle is considered to be "the maid of all maids" in the [[Knights of Favonius]], with many thinking she has the ability to be everywhere all at once. She is stubborn, however, and willing to unnecessarily endanger her life at any moment to help someone. She has tried many times to join the ranks of the Knights of Favonius to accomplish her dream of becoming a full-fledged knight, but has fallen short every time so far.

Abandoned as an infant, Razor was taken in by the [[Four Winds|Wolf of the North]] [[Boreas]] and raised by his wolf pack in [[Wolvendom]]. After a chance encounter with [[Varka]], the current Grand Master of the [[Knights of Favonius]], he has slowly started integrating with humans again through the help of his teacher [[Lisa]].

{{Lang|'''Qiqi'''|zh=七七|zh_rm=Qīqī}} is a playable {{Cryo}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

Resurrected as a [[zombie]] by the [[adepti]], she has ended up in [[Baizhu]]'s care and now works at [[Bubu Pharmacy]] in [[Liyue Harbor]].

According to [[Zibai]], Qiqi had her Three Deadly Selves severed, but unlike a complete process, only one damaged and incomplete self remains in her body. This fragment was likely shattered and later reassembled through adeptal magic, while the others are lost. The sigil on her forehead stabilizes what’s left of her soul, keeping her alive but leaving her with severe memory issues due to her incomplete state.<ref>Anecdote - [[Zibai: The Adeptus Arts, Once More]]</ref>

The '''Wanderer''' is a playable {{Anemo}} [[character]] in ''[[Genshin Impact]]''.

He was once '''Scaramouche''', the Sixth of the [[Eleven Fatui Harbingers]], also known by his codename "'''The Balladeer'''." After erasing his previous identities from [[Irminsul]], he became a drifter until he willingly regained his memories. He is currently a Driyosh of the [[Vahumana]] Darshan.<ref>{{Ref/Quest|Ripples That Will Never Reach|quote='''(‍Wanderer‍):''' And I'm a Driyosh from the Vahumana Darshan of the Sumeru Akademiya... Hat Guy.}}</ref>

During the {{Quest|As Though Morning Dew}}, the player can change the Wanderer's name, which will then be used in some of the game's interfaces, such as [[Party Setup]]. Most characters, however, will refer to him by the name of '''Hat Guy''', the name [[Nahida]] used upon enrolling him to [[Vahumana]].
